settings.title: Settings
settings.keysHint: A key is submitted once over HTTPS, stored encrypted server-side, never kept or echoed here; revoke any time.
settings.threadHint: New conversations use the model and approval policy set here. Conversations already open are not affected.

policy.on-request: On request: ask when Codex asks
policy.on-failure: On failure: ask only when the sandbox fails

settings.sandboxHint: Register a model key in Settings, then create your cloud sandbox. The first creation returns your agent token once.
settings.sandboxCapacityFull: Cloud sandboxes are at capacity right now. Please try again later; your key and settings are kept.
settings.reconnectHint: This replaces both the computer token and the cloud sandbox token: the old computer disconnects and a running sandbox restarts for a few dozen seconds
settings.sandboxRolled: The cloud sandbox is using the new token and is restarting
settings.rotateHint: The old tokens are revoked at the relay right away; the new command is shown once and a running sandbox rolls automatically.
settings.noticeProvisioned: Sandbox startup requested. Copy the token and initialize locally; it cannot be viewed again after refresh.
settings.noticeUpdated: Updated: the sandbox restarts with the new settings (about a minute), showing "Starting" then "Running". Your local agent needs nothing.
settings.noticeRestored: Restored: the sandbox is starting and your earlier work is kept. Your local agent does not need to reconnect.
settings.noticeDeleted: Removed: the sandbox is stopped and your work is kept. Start it again any time; no new command will be issued.
settings.noticeRotated: The old token is revoked. Initialize locally with the new token, then start the agent.
settings.confirmRotate: This replaces both the computer token and the cloud sandbox token: the old computer disconnects and a running sandbox restarts for a few dozen seconds. Continue?
settings.confirmDelete: Removing stops the sandbox (your work is kept) and sessions pause until you start it again. Remove it?
settings.copyManual: Automatic copying is unavailable. The text is selected; press Ctrl+C.
settings.agentTokenHint: Run this command in local PowerShell, then paste the token into the hidden prompt.
settings.lead: Register your own model key and set the model and approval policy for new conversations.
settings.machineEntryHint: The cloud sandbox only starts, updates and is removed here. Connecting a computer is in My computer below.

home.title: What do you want to work out today?

chat.name: Chat
chat.what: Question and answer. It can query our data; it does not touch files on your machine.

work.name: Work
work.what: Let it act in your project folder: read files, run commands, change files. You approve what matters.

expert.name: Expert
expert.what: Follows a fixed method step by step, checks every step, and writes the deliverable into the project files. Slower and costlier.

pick.chat: A chat does not need a project. With one, it can read the files in that project.
pick.work: Work happens inside a project: a folder on your machine.
pick.expert: The expert takes over the whole project: this conversation, its files and the other conversations.

approval.title: This goes beyond what is allowed and needs your approval

answered.acceptForSession: You allowed it; the same thing will not be asked again in this conversation
answered.accept_task: You allowed it; the same thing will not be asked again in this task

approval.expired: This request expired and was not executed
approval.failed: The answer was not sent. Please try again.
approval.dependents: Later steps that depend on it: {steps}
approval.afterDecline: Something was declined in this step just now; everything it wants to do next will be asked first.
approval.notePlaceholder: When declining: how it should change. When stopping: what to do differently when redoing this step

changes.title: Changes
changes.none: No files changed in this conversation yet.
changes.note: Only files changed through patches are listed here. Files it changed from the command line (for example by redirection) cannot be listed; look at the commands above.

handover.succeeded: The expert is done. The write-up and handback are under Work papers in the right panel; each request in this conversation is kept separately and never overwritten.
handover.stopped: The expert was stopped. Whatever it wrote is under Work papers in the right panel.
handover.failed: The expert did not finish. Whatever it wrote is under Work papers in the right panel.
handover.succeededNoFiles: The expert finished. It writes no deliverable files; the result is what it handed back in this conversation.
handover.stoppedNoFiles: The expert was stopped. It writes no deliverable files.
handover.failedNoFiles: The expert did not finish. It writes no deliverable files.
handover.rejected: The expert did not take this request; no step ran and nothing was written: {reason}
handover.rejectedPlain: The expert did not take this request; no step ran and nothing was written.

question.title: Codex is asking you
question.expired: This question expired; it continued on its own assumption

policy.denied: The advisor wanted to {command}; declined by the expert pack's rules

local.approved: You allowed this once on your computer: {scope}. The same directory and scope will not ask again for up to 30 minutes. Digest {digest}
local.denied: Not allowed on your computer: {scope}. To raise the limit for good, change it in the tray Settings. Digest {digest}

panel.terminalSoon: This will be a terminal in the project folder on your computer. It waits for the local agent's terminal channel (ledger 83).

list.title: Projects
list.lead: A project is a folder on your computer, plus what you chatted about, worked on, and what experts handed back around it.
list.none: No projects in this workspace yet.

noWorkspace.title: No workspace yet
noWorkspace.lead: A workspace is a root folder on your machine. Having none usually has one of these three causes:
noWorkspace.sandbox: No sandbox yet: register a model key in Settings, then start the sandbox in My computers.
noWorkspace.agent: No local agent connected yet: install the local agent on your machine and add a folder in it.
noWorkspace.account: Signed in with a different account: the local agent and the web page must use the same account.
noWorkspace.note: Workspaces are added and removed in the local agent on your machine, not on the web.

create.title: New project
create.pathHint: A folder relative to the workspace. Leave empty for the workspace itself. If the folder is not on the computer yet it is created; if it is, it is used as is.
create.name: Project name
create.nameHint: Left empty, the last part of the folder is used: {title}

problem.absolute: The subfolder must be relative to the workspace, not an absolute path.
problem.upward: The subfolder must not go upwards (no ..).
problem.project_exists: This folder is already a project.
problem.root_outside_whitelist: This workspace is not whitelisted on that machine.
problem.outside_whitelist: This place is outside the computer's workspaces, or the path goes through a link or alias; the agent does not write there.
problem.local_read_only: The computer's local setting is read-only. Allow writing in the local settings first.
problem.not_a_directory: There is a file with this name here, not a folder.
problem.target_not_empty: This subfolder already has content. Cloning needs a subfolder that does not exist or is empty.
problem.invalid_url: Use an https:// or ssh address, without a user name or password in it (you will be asked for a token if needed).
problem.auth_required: This repository needs a login: enter an access token below and clone again.
problem.ssh_auth_failed: An ssh address needs an ssh key set up on the computer; or use the https address.
problem.host_key_unknown: This computer has not accepted this host's ssh key yet. Connect once with git or ssh on the computer, confirm the key, then clone.
problem.repo_not_found: Repository not found, or you have no access to it.
problem.git_missing: Git is not installed on this computer. Install Git for Windows first.
problem.clone_timeout: The clone did not finish in 15 minutes and was stopped; the half-cloned folder was removed.
problem.clone_failed: The clone failed. Check the address and the network, then try again.
problem.cancelled: Cancelled; the half-cloned folder was removed.
problem.project_directory_missing: This folder is not on the computer; the project was not registered.
problem.no_agent_here: The agent on this computer went away; nothing was created.
problem.ticket_invalid: The pass for the agent expired. Click once more.
problem.local_failed: The agent could not do it. Please try again.

create.machinesFailed: Could not load computers. Try reloading; no project was created.
create.noMachine: Connect a computer and choose a directory before creating a project.
create.noRoots: This computer has no shared directories. Add and select directories in the local tray, save, then reopen this dialog.
create.repoHint: An https or ssh address. Your computer's own git login is used; for a private repository you have not logged in to, you will be asked for an access token.
create.clonePathHint: Which subfolder of the workspace to clone into. Left empty, the repository name is used. It must not exist yet, or be empty.
create.making: Creating the folder on your computer…
create.cloning: Cloning; a large repository takes a few minutes…

agent.checking: Looking for the agent on this computer…
agent.no_agent_here: Create projects on the computer that runs the agent: the folder is made there, and this computer has no running agent.
agent.other_account: The agent on this computer belongs to another account; you cannot create projects here.
agent.outdated: Update the agent on the computer to 0.4.1 to create projects.
agent.failed: Could not reach the agent on this computer. Try again later.

auth.title: This repository needs a login
auth.lead: Git on your computer has no login for this repository. Enter an access token: it goes only to the agent on your computer, for this clone, never through our servers.
auth.remember: Remember on this computer (saved by the computer's git credential manager; not asked again)

page.lead: A project is a folder on your computer, plus what you chatted about, worked on, and what experts handed back around it.
page.offlineNote: The machine is offline: you can look and chat, but not start work or ask an expert.
page.empty: Nothing in this project yet. Start with the three buttons above.
page.archiveBody: Once archived it no longer appears in the sidebar and the project list. Conversations and handbacks stay and it can be unarchived. Files on your computer are not affected.
page.problem: It did not work. Please try again.
page.noHandbacks: No expert has handed back yet. Deliverables live in the project files.

machines.title: My computers
machines.lead: Work and Expert read and write projects on your own computer. A local agent runs there and lets us touch only the folders you whitelisted.
machines.elsewhere: This is the computer connected to your account. If you are on a different computer now, install and connect it with the three steps below; {name} then disconnects, because an account drives one computer at a time.
machines.offlineNote: The agent is offline. Check the reason in the local tray and start it; if logon startup is enabled it starts after login.
machines.noRoots: No folder added yet. Add one in the local agent so projects have a place.

ceiling.title: The limits this machine sets for itself

sandbox.workspace-write: can change files only inside whitelisted folders

ceiling.note: These can only be changed on that machine. The web page shows them and cannot change them; however much we allow, it cannot go beyond them.

guide.title: Connect a computer
guide.connect: After installing, your computer opens this page with the code filled in; check the computer name and allow it
guide.evidence: An online computer means these three steps are done.
guide.onlineHint: Status updates every 5 seconds. Return to Work or Expert once the computer is online.

connect.title: Connect a computer
connect.hint: Eight characters. They are uppercased and a hyphen is inserted after the fourth. If this page did not open by itself, type the code shown on your computer here.
connect.prefilled: The connection code came from your computer. Make sure the computer below is yours, then allow it.
connect.wrong: The code is wrong or expired
connect.intoAccount: After you allow this, the computer connects to the account "{account}". If that is not the right account, deny, sign in with the right one and connect again.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.unlock: After downloading, right-click the ZIP, open Properties, check Unblock, extract, then double-click Install. This is not the main path.
advanced.copyFailed: Copy did not succeed. Try again.

setup.downloadFailed: Download information could not be loaded. No sandbox or token was changed.
setup.copyHint: Paste it into PowerShell and press Enter. It works for 10 minutes and only once
setup.tooFast: That was too fast. Wait and try again
setup.packageInfo: Version {version} · Codex {codex} · Windows x64 · Download {size} MiB
setup.installHint: Save the ZIP as windows-x64.zip in Downloads and run this in ordinary PowerShell. Verify the source and hashes first. An existing destination stops installation. Do not disable system protection if blocked.
setup.developmentOnly: Development-site package. Clean Windows and real reboot acceptance are still pending before public release.
setup.startTitle: Choose directories and start after initialization
setup.startHint: Complete local initialization above, then open tray settings, add and select project directories, save and start. Logon startup is an explicit tray option.
setup.oneMachine: Only one agent may be online per account. Connecting another replaces the existing connection.
setup.unknownExpiry: Not issued or a legacy token with no recorded expiry
setup.refreshRequired: The identity changed or an operation is still running. Status was refreshed. Review it before explicitly trying again; no automatic rotation occurs.
setup.needKey: Register a model key in Settings first, then create your sandbox to receive the first token.
setup.operationFailed: Operation not confirmed ({code}). Check status before retrying. If the first token was lost, explicitly request a replacement.
setup.statusFailed: Status could not be loaded. Actions are disabled; refresh the page to retry.
setup.tokenCopied: Copied. Paste only into the hidden local initialization prompt; clear the clipboard afterwards.
setup.tokenMemory: Shown on this page once, cleared after five minutes, navigation or refresh. Do not paste into chat or command arguments. Copying uses the system clipboard; avoid cross-device clipboard synchronization.
setup.afterInit: The command prompts for hidden token input locally. Then follow the next step, “Choose directories and start after initialization”.

library.title: Library
library.lead: Your materials with us. Working papers handed back by experts and files returned by work appear here automatically; each one has a copy on the server that belongs only to you. Files on your computer are not here; experts read them on your machine.
library.failed: Could not load; try again later.
library.emptyHint: Working papers and returned files will appear here automatically. Uploading your own files comes later.
library.notFoundHint: Try another word or clear the filter.
library.note: Only filed materials are here. Removing takes an item out of the library; the conversation and working paper stay.

item.notFound: No such item, or it was removed from the library.
item.copy: This item has a copy on the server that belongs only to you.
item.confirmRemove: It will no longer show here; the conversation and working paper stay. Sure?
item.failed: That did not work; try again.

computerConnection.welcome: First add your model key in Settings, then connect your computer so Work and Expert can read and write your files.

memory.title: Long-term memory
memory.intro: These lines go at the start of every conversation you have. Only you can see them. Write facts about yourself: what you follow, which figures you use, how you like answers.
memory.addPlaceholder: e.g. For banks use pre-provision profit; answer conclusion first

computer.localLead: Folders, limits, autostart and the local library directory live in the agent on your computer. Changes made here go straight to that computer, not through the cloud; widening changes (adding a folder, raising the limit, enabling network, setting the library directory, enabling autostart) need one confirmation on that computer, after which the agent restarts itself.
computer.readOnlyFrom: Below is what the agent last reported (read-only):
computer.addRootPlaceholder: Absolute path on the computer, e.g. D:\research

sandbox.workspace-write: Write only inside the whitelisted folders

computer.libraryDirPlaceholder: One directory; leave empty for none
computer.confirmOnComputer: This widens access: enter the code in the confirmation window on the computer and allow it.
computer.saved: Saved. The agent is restarting; this refreshes in a few seconds.

failure.local_denied: Not allowed on the computer; nothing changed.
failure.busy: The agent is busy (maybe restarting); try again shortly.
failure.invalid: One item is not acceptable (folder missing, duplicated, or more than 32); nothing changed.
failure.no_agent_here: The agent on this computer is gone; nothing was sent.
failure.ticket_invalid: The local access ticket was not accepted; reload and try again.

settings.baseUrlHint: A self-hosted or proxied OpenAI-compatible endpoint; https only, no local or private addresses. Leave empty for the vendor default.

localLibrary.title: Local library
localLibrary.lead: A directory on your computer for material you want to keep; work and expert conversations can read it. This page reads straight from your computer, nothing goes to the cloud, so it is only visible on the computer that runs the agent.
